h1:
10 Scenic Stays
in Sam Roi Yot, Prachuap Khiri Khan
That We've Reviewed
heroSub: 10 hand-picked scenic stays in Sam Roi Yot district that we've reviewed in depth — rice-field cottages by the sea that frame the mountains, paddies and ocean in one shot, pool suites you can step into the pool from your door, a family beach resort on Dolphin Bay, all the way to small owner-run boutique lodges. Prices start around ฿1,200–6,500/night.
heroStats: ✅ Honest take from real reviews at every stay
introH2: 🏝️ What kinds of scenic stays are there in Sam Roi Yot, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: Sam Roi Yot district sits about 30–40 km south of Hua Hin and Pranburi, and it's the area people fleeing Hua Hin's crowds tend to overlook — even though it has a completely different kind of charm. Instead of a resort town packed with malls and nightlife, Sam Roi Yot sells nature, quiet, and the limestone-mountain views of Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park that form the backdrop to nearly every stay · So the places here come in many forms. Some are wooden rice-field cottages by the sea that frame the mountains, paddies and ocean in a single shot. Some are pool suites you can step straight into the pool from your door, set in a coconut grove. Some are family beach resorts on Dolphin Bay with slides for the kids. And some are small boutique lodges where the owners look after guests themselves · A lot of people book a Sam Roi Yot stay expecting city-style convenience, then find the location fairly remote and that you really need a car, and feel it didn't match what they had in mind · This article rounds up 10 scenic stays in Sam Roi Yot that we've reviewed in depth — across Sam Roi Yot Beach, Dolphin Bay and Bang Pu Beach — each one based on reading real guest reviews, with both the good points and the honest caveats, prices compared across 3 sites, and direct booking links for all of them
mrtHtml: Sam Roi Yot has no rail system and very limited public transport, so having your own car or renting a car/motorbike is the easiest way around · From Bangkok it's about a 3-hour drive, and from Hua Hin town it's about 30–40 km (roughly a 40–50 min drive) · The stay areas in this article: Sam Roi Yot Beach — a long, quiet sandy beach with both beachfront resorts and pool suites in coconut groves, walkable to the sea · Dolphin Bay — a curved bay at the foot of Khao Sam Roi Yot, good for families and anyone after privacy · Bang Pu Beach — a quiet corner near Phraya Nakhon Cave, for people who really want to get away from the crowds · All of these make a good base for visiting Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park, Phraya Nakhon Cave and the Sam Roi Yot wetlands

entries.type: Beachfront Pool Suite Resort · Sam Roi Yot
entries.name: The Beach Village Resort
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.6 · 35 reviews · TripAdvisor 4.5/5 #3 in Sam Roi Yot
entries.badge: 🏊 Step into the pool from your door
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Moo 4, Sam Roi Yot · ~5 min walk to the beach
tags: 🏊 Step into the pool from your door
entries.addr: 602 Moo 4, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, Sam Roi Yot District
entries.storyHtml: We open the list with a stay that plays on the idea of a "beach village" set in a coconut grove — The Beach Village Resort is a mid-sized pool-suite resort of around 34 rooms spread across more than 9 rai of shady coconut grove, just about a 5-minute walk from Sam Roi Yot Beach · The thing every review agrees on is that many of the suites are designed so you can open your door and step straight into the swimming pool, like having a private pool right outside your room — a feature families with young kids and couples after privacy love · The rooms are Premium One Bedroom and Two Bedroom Pool Suites, both with and without a rooftop terrace, and several reviews praise how spacious they are, with high ceilings, feeling more like a holiday home than a hotel · The main restaurant is the Coconut Restaurant, serving Thai and Western dishes by a chef with 5-star hotel experience, with fresh seafood from Sam Roi Yot waters as the highlight · The honest take from real reviews lines up: this suits people who want to escape the bustle for some quiet in nature, and use Sam Roi Yot as a base for Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park and Phraya Nakhon Cave · The honest caveats reviews mention are that the location is fairly remote and hard to find the first time, since it's down a village lane — turn on GPS or call ahead for directions; there aren't many activities or much entertainment at the resort; the restaurant menu isn't very varied and the cooking can be inconsistent at times; and some maintenance details are starting to show their age, such as wet-style bathrooms that drain poorly in some rooms · Overall it's a good-value pick among walk-in pool suites, especially for families and groups of friends where the per-head cost works out cheaper
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Specify when booking that you want a room you can step into the pool from, since not every room sits on the pool · If you're a big family or a group of friends, the Two Bedroom Pool Suite is better value and more comfortable, and you should have your own car since public transport in the area is limited
pros: Many suites let you step into the pool from your door, good for families
Quiet, private atmosphere in a 9-rai coconut grove
About a 5-min walk to Sam Roi Yot Beach · Coconut Restaurant, 5-star chef
Attentive, helpful staff · free bicycles, free parking
cons: Location is fairly remote and hard to find the first time, a car helps
Not many resort activities · restaurant menu isn't very varied
Some maintenance details starting to show their age (from reviews)

entries.name: La A Natu Bed & Bakery
entries.revCount: Average around 9.1 · 215 reviews · TripAdvisor #1 B&B in Sam Roi Yot
entries.badge: 🛖 Mountains, paddies and sea in one shot
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Moo 2, Sam Roi Yot · private beachfront
entries.addr: 234 Moo 2, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, Sam Roi Yot District
entries.storyHtml: If there's one stay famous for being the most scenic in Sam Roi Yot, many reviews give it to this one — La A Natu Bed & Bakery, which Thais call "La A Natu, the rice-field cottages," is a 4-star beachfront boutique resort with only about 12 rooms, selling a rare kind of quiet and privacy · The thing every review agrees on is the location, with mountains, rice fields and the sea all in one frame, especially the "Chocolate Pool" that looks out on all three at once — the signature shot people travel here to take · The "rice-field cottage" concept blends vernacular Thai architecture with Balinese and minimal design, divided into stilted wooden cottages amid the paddies and beachfront houses, with rooms ranging from the Tropical Village in the fields to the Tropical Cottage by the beach, all the way to beachfront suites with a private pool · Two more things that have become signatures are the quiet private beach in front of the resort and the homemade bakery with its Afternoon Tea set, both of which come up often in reviews · It opened back in 2007 and had a major renovation in 2020, holding the #1 spot among Sam Roi Yot's B&Bs on TripAdvisor · The honest take from real reviews is fairly clear: this is a stay for couples and people who came to relax quietly and take beautiful photos, more than families with young kids or activity-seekers · The honest caveats reviews mention are that the price is fairly high compared with other stays in the same area; there aren't many resort activities, since the focus is on quiet; the location is remote and you need a car; and because there are so few rooms it fills up fast on holidays, so book well ahead
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want the mountains-paddies-sea in one frame, ask for a room in the rice-field zone facing the Chocolate Pool · Book well ahead, since there are only about 12 rooms and it fills up fast on holidays, and don't forget to use your Afternoon Tea with the signature homemade bakery
pros: Location frames mountains, rice fields and sea in one shot, the Chocolate Pool is beautiful
Quiet private beach, romantic atmosphere good for couples
Homemade bakery and Afternoon Tea set are signatures
TripAdvisor #1 among Sam Roi Yot's B&Bs
cons: Highest price in this article, compared with other stays in the area
Only about 12 rooms, fills up fast, book well ahead
Not many resort activities · remote location, need a car (from reviews)

entries.name: The Green Beach Resort
entries.revCount: Around 8.7–9.2 · 744 reviews · TripAdvisor #5 in Sam Roi Yot
entries.badge: 🏖️ Walk to the sea on an easy budget
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sam Roi Yot beachfront · walk to the sea
entries.addr: 232 Moo 5, Soi Sam Roi Yot 25, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict
entries.storyHtml: If you're after a beachfront stay you can walk to the sea from on the lightest budget in this article, The Green Beach Resort is the answer many reviews point to — a 3-star beachfront resort of around 47 rooms set right on Sam Roi Yot Beach, in the part of Sam Roi Yot district bordering Pranburi · The clearest selling point is a beachfront location just a few steps from a long, quiet sandy beach with limestone mountains as a backdrop, plus a large pool in the garden with a well-kept separate kids' pool · There are several room types from Deluxe Pool View and Superior Pool View to Deluxe Villa and family rooms, decorated simply in warm tones with a private balcony · There's a Krua The Green restaurant, free bicycle rental for riding along the shore, free parking, and a banquet room that holds up to 120 people, good for groups and functions · The honest take from real reviews lines up: the quiet beachfront location, the well-kept large pool, attentive staff, and the value make it good for families and people who want to escape the city's bustle · The honest caveats worth knowing are that this is not a luxury resort — it's an easygoing seaside stay focused on value over luxury, so the finishes and freshness of some rooms reflect the price point, and in Sam Roi Yot district where public transport is limited, having your own car is more convenient · It suits people who want a beachfront room within walking distance of the sea at an affordable price
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Choose a Pool View room or Villa facing the pool for a nicer atmosphere · Use the resort's free bicycles to ride along Sam Roi Yot Beach in the morning or evening, and if you're a group, ask about the banquet room that holds up to 120 people
pros: Sam Roi Yot beachfront location, just a few steps to the sea
Big well-kept pool with a separate kids' pool, good for families
Lightest starting price in this article, from ฿1,200/night, good value
Free bicycles, free parking · attentive staff (from reviews)
cons: Not a luxury resort, the freshness of some rooms reflects the price
In Sam Roi Yot district, public transport is limited, a car helps
Focused on value over luxury (from reviews)

entries.name: Oriental Beach Pearl Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sam Roi Yot · ~1 km from Dolphin Bay
entries.addr: 265 Moo 2, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, Sam Roi Yot District
entries.storyHtml: Among Sam Roi Yot's stays, if you measure by an unusual look and great photos, Oriental Beach Pearl Resort is the one that stands out on design — a Mediterranean-style pool villa resort, with white buildings against the sky in Santorini fashion, set about 1 km from Dolphin Bay and roughly a 5-minute drive from Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park · What reviews mention most is that many of the villas have a private pool you can step into from your door, plus a rooftop with a jacuzzi and a barbecue and a fully equipped kitchen, which groups of friends and families who want to grill while taking in the view from the rooftop love · There are several room types from the entry-level Lotus Townhouse to Deluxe, Executive and Royal Pool Villas of 1–3 bedrooms · The shared facilities are more loaded than at many stays in the area, with several outdoor pools, a 62-meter water slide, a saltwater pool, a pool bar, a tennis court, an 18-hole mini golf course, a petanque court, a fitness room, a spa, and the Sala Bo restaurant serving Thai, Danish and international food · The honest take from real reviews is that it suits families, groups of friends, and couples who want privacy alongside a variety of resort activities · The honest caveats worth knowing are that it's not right on the beach — you have to drive or walk about 1 km to Dolphin Bay; the pretty white-and-blue design is starting to show some wear in places with age and upkeep; and because the grounds are large with several zones, the walk from a villa to the central areas can be fairly long at times · It suits groups and families who want a striking-design pool villa with a rooftop BBQ on an affordable budget
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're a group, choose a villa with a rooftop jacuzzi and BBQ to grill while taking in the evening view · Kids will love the 62-meter water slide and the mini golf, and have a car ready since you'll need to travel about 1 km to Dolphin Bay
pros: White Santorini-style villa design, photogenic and unusual
Villas have a pool outside the door, rooftop jacuzzi and BBQ, good for groups
Loaded shared areas, 62 m slide, mini golf, tennis, spa
Affordable starting price, from ฿1,790/night
cons: Not right on the beach, about 1 km to Dolphin Bay
Pretty design but starting to show wear in places (from reviews)
Large grounds with several zones, villa-to-center walk is fairly long

entries.name: Dolphin Bay Resort
entries.revCount: TripAdvisor 4.5/5 · 627 reviews · #1 in Sam Roi Yot
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Dolphin Bay · next to Khao Sam Roi Yot
tags: 🏝️ Monkey Island & Phraya Nakhon Cave tours
entries.addr: 227 Moo 4, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, Sam Roi Yot District
entries.storyHtml: If you measure by review count and ranking, Dolphin Bay Resort is the one that holds #1 of 16 hotels in Sam Roi Yot on TripAdvisor, with a 4.5 from 627 real reviews — the most in this article · It's a family beach resort on Dolphin Bay, set next to Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park on a sandy beach about 5 km long, and it's the area's first and largest resort with around 59 rooms · What makes families love it is two central pools with water slides and fountains, a shallow separate kids' pool, a wooden playground, and a kids' play room set up specifically for children · The rooms range from a 24-sq-m Superior Bungalow with garden or pool views to a 3-bedroom family suite with a private pool and a 6-bedroom pool villa, accommodating everyone from couples to large multi-generation families · Another highlight reviews mention is Cafe Loma, a beachfront restaurant serving Thai-Western dishes and fresh seafood, plus boat tours to Monkey Island and trips to Phraya Nakhon Cave, which make the resort a complete base for exploring nature · The honest take from real reviews is that it suits families with kids and people who want a beachfront resort with activities ready to go · The honest caveats worth knowing are that, being the area's first resort, some rooms and facilities aren't new and are starting to show their age; the location is remote and you need a car; and on long holidays when lots of families come, the pools and shared areas can get busy enough that it's not very quiet · It suits families bringing kids to swim by the sea with a full set of activities
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're a big multi-generation family, the 3-bedroom family suite with a private pool is better value and more comfortable · Book the boat tour to Monkey Island and Phraya Nakhon Cave with the resort at check-in, and avoid long holidays if you want a quiet atmosphere
pros: TripAdvisor #1 in Sam Roi Yot, from 627 real reviews
On Dolphin Bay next to Khao Sam Roi Yot, sandy beach about 5 km long
2 slide pools, separate kids' pool, playground, good for families
Beachfront Cafe Loma, Monkey Island & Phraya Nakhon Cave tours, all in one place
cons: It's the area's first resort, some rooms starting to show their age
Remote location, need your own car
On long holidays lots of families come, shared areas can get busy (from reviews)

entries.name: The Privacy Beach Resort & Spa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Dolphin Bay · on the beach, quiet
entries.addr: 252 Moo 3, Dolphin Bay, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, Sam Roi Yot District
entries.storyHtml: Among the Dolphin Bay resorts, The Privacy Beach Resort & Spa is the one whose name fits the concept best — focused on quiet and seaside privacy · It's a mid-sized beachfront resort of around 62 rooms set right on Dolphin Bay, with the limestone range of Khao Sam Roi Yot as a backdrop, no vendor stalls, no crowds of tourists, just the sound of the waves and the sea breeze · What many people mention is an outdoor pool roughly 72 meters long stretching through the middle of the resort, far longer than the pools at many stays in this area · There are several room types from studios and twin rooms to beach villas and private pool villas, with the Siam Dining restaurant serving Thai and international food, a poolside bar, a spa, a fitness room, a ballroom, free bicycle loans, and free parking · The honest take from real reviews is that it suits people who came to relax quietly by the sea, wanting a private beach and a long pool to swim in · The honest caveat we have to be straight about is that the review score here is middling (3.7 of 5 from 53 reviews on TripAdvisor), lower than the standout stays in this article, with reviews mentioning age and inconsistent maintenance in places, service that sometimes doesn't match the price, and a remote location where you need a car · It suits people who weight a long pool and a private beach above all else, and set their expectations on room freshness accordingly — read the latest reviews and look at the room photos before booking
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If privacy matters most, choose a beach villa or pool villa in a separate building · Read the latest reviews and look at the room photos before booking, since the score is middling and maintenance is inconsistent in places, and have your own car ready as the location is fairly remote
pros: Right on Dolphin Bay beach, quiet and private
Pool roughly 72 meters long, longer than other stays in the area
Has private pool villas, a spa, fitness, and a private beach out front
Free bicycle loans, free parking
cons: Middling review score (3.7/5), lower than the standout stays in this article
Age and inconsistent maintenance in places (from reviews)
Fairly remote location, need a car · service sometimes doesn't match the price

entries.name: Away Pranburi Beach Resort
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.6 · 21 reviews · now known as La Isla Pranburi
entries.badge: 🏖️ Quiet Bang Pu Beach under Khao Sam Roi Yot
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bang Pu Beach · near Phraya Nakhon Cave
entries.addr: 99 Moo 9, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, Sam Roi Yot District
entries.storyHtml: If "getting away" is what you're after, Away Pranburi Beach Resort plays on that fully — a beachfront resort on Bang Pu Beach in a quiet corner of Sam Roi Yot district, near Phraya Nakhon Cave and Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park · It was originally called Pulakorn, then renovated and renamed, and currently goes by La Isla Pranburi Beach Resort — so if you search the name and find several, don't doubt it, it's the same place, same building, same location · What reviews mention is that you wake up, open your door, and there's the sea with the limestone range of Khao Sam Roi Yot as a backdrop; you step into a big pool set against the lawn and a private sandy beach, and all day you barely hear anything but the waves · The roughly 44 rooms are split into Sea View, Pool Access, Pool Villa and Suite, accommodating everyone from couples to families · There's the Pulakorn restaurant serving Thai food, a massage spa, a kids' club, and a highlight reviews love — boat trips to see the fishing-village life and the Khao Sam Roi Yot coast, which let you experience the local fishing community · The honest take from real reviews is that it suits people who want to escape Hua Hin's bustle for genuine quiet and seaside privacy · The honest caveats worth knowing are that the review count is still small (21 reviews on Trip.com) because it was just renovated and renamed; the location is in a quiet, remote corner with limited public transport, so you need your own car; and because the focus is on quiet, there aren't many restaurants or much entertainment around the stay — mostly you'll eat at the resort or drive out · It suits people who want a quiet private beach under Khao Sam Roi Yot
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want the sea-and-mountain view, choose a Sea View or Pool Access room facing the beach · Book the boat trip to see the fishing-village life and the Khao Sam Roi Yot coast with the resort, and have your own car ready since the location is in a quiet, remote corner
pros: Quiet private Bang Pu Beach with Khao Sam Roi Yot as a backdrop
Big pool set against the lawn and the sandy beach
Boat trips to see the fishing-village life and the Khao Sam Roi Yot coast
Good for people who genuinely want to escape Hua Hin's bustle
cons: Review count is still small (21 reviews) because it was just renovated and renamed
Location is in a quiet, remote corner, need your own car
Few restaurants or entertainment around the stay (from reviews)

entries.name: Long Beach Inn
entries.revCount: TripAdvisor 4.7/5 · 269 reviews · #2 in Sam Roi Yot
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phu Noi Beach · 150 m to the beach
entries.addr: 223 Moo 4, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, Sam Roi Yot District
entries.storyHtml: If you want a small stay where the owner looks after guests personally, with the feel of staying at a friend's place, Long Beach Inn is the one reviews hold up as the example — a small boutique inn of around 33 rooms in the Phu Noi Beach area, next to Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park, about 150 meters from the beach · It's run by a foreign owner (Bram) who looks after guests himself, which reviews mention again and again, with warm, detail-minded care that feels like staying at a friend's house · Every room is non-smoking with a private balcony, air-con, fridge, minibar and safe, and inside there's a shady tropical garden, an outdoor pool with a jacuzzi, and a massage room · Another thing reviews love is the cooked-to-order (à la carte) breakfast rather than a buffet kept warm, and it's a pet-friendly stay, which is rare in this area, so people bringing their dogs or cats choose it · The honest take from real reviews is that it suits couples, travelers who like small, warm stays, and people using Sam Roi Yot as a base for Khao Sam Roi Yot and Phraya Nakhon Cave · TripAdvisor ranks it #2 of 16 hotels in Sam Roi Yot, with a 4.7 from 269 reviews, and it has won a Travelers' Choice award · The honest caveats worth knowing are that it's not on the beach — you walk about 150 meters to the sea; it's a small inn, so the shared facilities aren't as grand as a big resort's; and in an area where public transport is limited, you should have your own car · It suits people who weight warm, personal care and a cozy atmosphere over luxury
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're bringing a pet, tell the inn when booking, since it's a rare pet-friendly stay in the area · Order the cooked-to-order breakfast reviews love, and ask the owner about routes to Khao Sam Roi Yot and Phraya Nakhon Cave, since he looks after guests himself and gives good advice
pros: Owner looks after guests himself, warm and friendly like staying at a friend's place
Cooked-to-order breakfast, not a buffet kept warm
Pet-friendly, which is rare in the area
TripAdvisor #2 in Sam Roi Yot · shady garden, pool + jacuzzi
cons: Not on the beach, about a 150-meter walk to the sea
It's a small inn, shared areas aren't as grand as a big resort's
Limited public transport in the area, a car helps (from reviews)

entries.name: Lyndale Lodge
entries.badge: 🏡 Highest score in this article · owner-run
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi 21, Sam Roi Yot · ~400 m walk to the beach
entries.addr: 246 Moo 4, Soi 21, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, Sam Roi Yot District
entries.storyHtml: Of all the stays in this article, Lyndale Lodge is the one with the highest review score at 9.3 on Booking.com and Trip.com and 4.8 on TripAdvisor — a very small boutique lodge / B&B of only about 6 rooms in Sam Roi Yot district · It's run by a British owner (David) and his wife (Nat) who look after every guest themselves, which is the heart of why the score is this high · The thing every review agrees on is the personal, detail-minded care, more like being welcomed into a home than staying at a hotel · The stay is at Soi 21, Moo 4, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, about 360–450 meters from Sam Roi Yot Beach, a few minutes' walk, and about 4 km from Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park · There's a saltwater pool in a shady garden, a bar with happy hour, a balcony and terrace, a massage room, a grilling area, free high-speed Wi-Fi, free parking, and a full set of services including laundry, airport transfers, and car/motorbike rental · The rooms are Standard Double, Deluxe Double and Family Room, with private balconies (upper rooms have a wraparound balcony), and a cooked-to-order breakfast served 7:30–10:00 · The honest take from real reviews is that it suits couples and travelers who like a small, quiet, warm stay and value personal care · The honest caveats worth knowing are that with only about 6 rooms it fills up very fast and you must book well ahead; it's not suited to big families or groups wanting resort-style facilities; it's not on the beach, so you walk about 400 meters; and in an area where public transport is limited, you should have a car · It suits people looking for a small, high-scoring stay where the owners care for you personally
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book well ahead, since there are only about 6 rooms and it fills up very fast · Use the saltwater pool that doesn't sting your eyes and the bar's happy hour, and ask David and Nat about routes to Khao Sam Roi Yot, since they look after guests themselves and give detailed advice
pros: Highest review score in this article, 9.3 · TripAdvisor 4.8/5
Owners David and Nat look after guests personally with attention to every detail
Saltwater pool in a shady garden · cooked-to-order breakfast
About a 400-meter walk to Sam Roi Yot Beach · full set of services
cons: Only about 6 rooms, fills up very fast, book well ahead
Not suited to big families or people wanting resort-style facilities
Not on the beach, about a 400-meter walk · a car helps (from reviews)

entries.type: Poolside Boutique Resort · Walk to the Beach
entries.name: Cordelia Resort Samroiyod
entries.badge: 🏊 Rooms open to the pool, 4 min to the beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi 21, Sam Roi Yot · 4 min walk to the beach
tags: 🏊 Rooms open to the pool edge
entries.addr: 224/1 Moo 4, Soi 21, Sam Roi Yot Subdistrict, Sam Roi Yot District
entries.storyHtml: We close the list with a small boutique resort with an especially high value score — Cordelia Resort Samroiyod is a small boutique resort of around 23 rooms in Sam Roi Yot district, with a long pool set in the middle of a contemporary building · The selling point reviews mention most is that many rooms open straight out to the edge of the pool, with a pool view or a view of the inner courtyard garden, which is why people who want a poolside room on an inexpensive budget choose it · There are 7 room types, from Standard with a garden view and Deluxe with a pool view to Pool Access, with roomy rooms, a sitting area, a king-size bed, a flat-screen TV, and some rooms with a balcony · There are two outdoor pools including a kids' pool, an American-style restaurant, free bicycles, free private parking, and a garden terrace · The location is about 200 meters or 4 minutes' walk from Sam Roi Yot Beach, and near Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park and Phraya Nakhon Cave · What makes it interesting is the real review scores on Booking.com that stand out for cleanliness at 9.6, location at 9.5, and value at 9.9, the highest value score in this article · The honest take from real reviews is that it suits couples and small families who want a poolside room within walking distance of the beach at an affordable price · The honest caveats worth knowing are that the review count is still small (47), since it's a small, fairly new resort; it's not on the beach, so you walk about 200 meters; and in an area where public transport is limited, you should have a car · It suits people looking for a room that opens to the pool within walking distance of the beach at the best value in the area
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want a poolside room, choose Pool Access or a Deluxe with a pool view at booking · The walk to Sam Roi Yot Beach is an easy 200 meters or so, and use the resort's free bicycles to ride around the area, since public transport is limited
pros: Many rooms open straight out to the edge of the pool
Value score of 9.9 and cleanliness 9.6 on Booking.com
About a 200-meter walk to Sam Roi Yot Beach (4 minutes)
Separate kids' pool, free bicycles, free parking, good for small families
cons: Review count is still small (47), since it's a small, fairly new resort
Not on the beach, about a 200-meter walk
Limited public transport in the area, a car helps (from reviews)

advice.bodyHtml: → La A Natu Bed & Bakery ฿6,500, rice-field cottages by the sea that frame mountains-paddies-sea in one shot, the Chocolate Pool, a private beach, TripAdvisor #1 B&B

advice.head: Want a room you step into the pool from
advice.bodyHtml: → The Beach Village Resort ฿2,000, pool suites in a coconut grove, or Cordelia Resort ฿1,900, rooms that open to the pool edge, value score 9.9

advice.head: Family trip with kids, want activities ready to go
advice.bodyHtml: → Dolphin Bay Resort ฿2,500, on Dolphin Bay, 2 slide pools, a separate kids' pool, Monkey Island tours, TripAdvisor #1 in Sam Roi Yot

advice.head: Want a beachfront room on the lightest budget
advice.bodyHtml: → The Green Beach Resort ฿1,200, a beachfront resort on Sam Roi Yot Beach, walk to the sea, a big pool, free bicycles, the lightest start in this article

advice.head: Like a small, owner-run, warm stay

faqTitle: FAQ — questions travelers often ask about Sam Roi Yot stays, Prachuap Khiri Khan

faq.q: ❓ Which is the most scenic stay in Sam Roi Yot?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style · If you measure by atmosphere and the beauty of the view, La A Natu Bed & Bakery, rice-field cottages by the sea that frame mountains-paddies-sea in one shot, is the stay reviews call the most scenic · If you measure by review score, Lyndale Lodge is the highest in this article at 9.3 · If you're a family with kids, Dolphin Bay Resort on Dolphin Bay is TripAdvisor #1 · If you want a room you step into the pool from on a light budget, The Beach Village Resort or Cordelia Resort

faq.q: ❓ How much do Sam Roi Yot stays cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start around ฿1,200–6,500 per night · The most accessible are The Green Beach Resort from ฿1,200, Long Beach Inn and Lyndale Lodge from ฿1,600, and Oriental Beach Pearl from ฿1,790 · The mid-range are Cordelia ฿1,900, The Beach Village and Away Pranburi ฿2,000, Dolphin Bay ฿2,500, and The Privacy ฿3,000 · And at the top is La A Natu from ฿6,500 · All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard room; on long holidays prices can be higher than usual

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best to stay in Sam Roi Yot?
faq.a: Sam Roi Yot Beach suits people who want a long, quiet sandy beach within walking distance of the sea (The Green Beach, The Beach Village, Lyndale Lodge, Cordelia) · Dolphin Bay, a curved bay at the foot of Khao Sam Roi Yot, suits families and people who like privacy (Dolphin Bay, The Privacy, Oriental Beach Pearl, which is about 1 km away) · Bang Pu Beach, a quiet corner near Phraya Nakhon Cave, suits people who really want to get away from the crowds (Away Pranburi) · All of these make a base for Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park and Phraya Nakhon Cave

faq.q: ❓ Do you need a car to visit Sam Roi Yot?
faq.a: You should have one · Sam Roi Yot is a small district with very limited public transport, and many stays are down village lanes in fairly remote spots, so having your own car or renting a car/motorbike is the easiest way around, especially if you want to visit Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park, Phraya Nakhon Cave and the Sam Roi Yot wetlands · From Bangkok it's about a 3-hour drive, and from Hua Hin town it's about 30–40 km · If you don't have a car, many stays offer motorbike rental or transfers, so ask and plan your travel ahead

faq.q: ❓ Which Sam Roi Yot stay is good for families with kids?
faq.a: The best is Dolphin Bay Resort on Dolphin Bay, with 2 slide pools, a shallow separate kids' pool, a wooden playground, and a kids' play room, plus a 3-bedroom family suite · Next are The Green Beach Resort, a beachfront stay with a big pool and a kids' pool on a light budget, The Beach Village Resort, where many rooms let you step into the pool from your door so kids play in view, and Oriental Beach Pearl Resort, with a 62-meter water slide and mini golf

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should you book a Sam Roi Yot stay?
faq.a: It depends on the stay and the time of year · Small stays like La A Natu (around 12 rooms) and Lyndale Lodge (around 6 rooms) fill up very fast, so book 1–2 months ahead or more, especially on long holidays and in high season · Larger stays like Dolphin Bay and The Green Beach also fill up fast on long holidays when lots of families come · On ordinary weekdays 1–2 weeks is enough · Most platforms usually offer Free Cancellation, so it's worth locking in a price like that if your plans aren't firm, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best rate
